correctness.rationale: Verified G(8,3) as 16-vertex 24-edge cubic graph, including all vertex distance spheres (1,3,6,5,1). Independently checked every edge N2[x]∪N2[y]=V\{τ(x),τ(y)} and τ permutes the 24 edges. This proves the exact closed-ball Čech_5 equals combinatorial Alexander dual Ind(G)^*. Independently enumerated all 1,090 nonempty independent faces, generated 542 distinct toggled pairs, topologically sorted all 4,272 oriented incidences (acyclic), and algebraically cancelled all 542 ±1 pivots over integers; critical cells are one vertex, four 3-cells, one 4-cell with zero integer differentials. Thus reduced integral Ind homology Z^4 in degree3 and Z in degree4, with no torsion, and Alexander duality on 16 vertices gives Čech_5 reduced H10=Z^4,H9=Z. Also reproduced GF2 ranks (15,81,191,181,58,14,2) as secondary check. At radius4 all 16 facets size10 and intersections ≤7, so no 9-cycle and no H≥10; at radius6 the 16 facets form ∂Δ15=S14, radius7 a full simplex. Given left-closed critical scales these establish every j≥9 barcode interval, without claiming low-degree persistence.
